cat > /app/analyze_logs.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Log Rotation Analyzer Script
# This script analyzes log files and generates reports

# Get current date for calculations
CURRENT_DATE=$(date +%s)

# Function to get file size in MB
get_size_mb() {
    local file=$1
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        local size_bytes=$(stat -c%s "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        echo "scale=2; $size_bytes / 1048576" | bc
    else
        echo "0"
    fi
}

# Function to get days since last modification
get_days_since_mod() {
    local file=$1
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        local mod_time=$(stat -c%Y "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo $CURRENT_DATE)
        local diff=$((CURRENT_DATE - mod_time))
        echo $((diff / 86400))
    else
        echo "0"
    fi
}

# Collect log file data
declare -A LOG_SIZES
declare -A LOG_DAYS
declare -A LOG_GROWTH
declare -A LOG_RETENTION
declare -A LOG_IMPORTANCE

# Data from log_metadata.json
LOG_GROWTH["access.log"]=45.7
LOG_GROWTH["app.log"]=12.5
LOG_GROWTH["system.log"]=25.3
LOG_GROWTH["error.log"]=8.9
LOG_GROWTH["debug.log"]=5.3

LOG_RETENTION["access.log"]=14
LOG_RETENTION["app.log"]=30
LOG_RETENTION["system.log"]=90
LOG_RETENTION["error.log"]=60
LOG_RETENTION["debug.log"]=7

LOG_IMPORTANCE["access.log"]="medium"
LOG_IMPORTANCE["app.log"]="high"
LOG_IMPORTANCE["system.log"]="high"
LOG_IMPORTANCE["error.log"]="critical"
LOG_IMPORTANCE["debug.log"]="low"

# Calculate actual file sizes
TOTAL_SIZE=0
for logfile in /var/log/samples/*.log; do
    if [ -f "$logfile" ]; then
        basename=$(basename "$logfile")
        size=$(get_size_mb "$logfile")
        days=$(get_days_since_mod "$logfile")
        LOG_SIZES["$basename"]=$size
        LOG_DAYS["$basename"]=$days
        TOTAL_SIZE=$(echo "$TOTAL_SIZE + $size" | bc)
    fi
done

# Generate analysis_report.txt
cat > /app/analysis_report.txt << 'REPORT_END'
LOG ROTATION ANALYSIS REPORT
============================
Generated: $(date)

SYSTEM OVERVIEW
---------------
Disk Partition Usage: 78%
Available Disk Space: 50 GB
Compliance Requirements: PCI-DSS, SOX
Backup Frequency: Daily

Current Issues Detected:
- High disk usage on log partition
- Inconsistent rotation schedules
- Missing compression on some logs
- Some critical logs lack rotation configuration

LOG FILE ANALYSIS
-----------------
REPORT_END

   - access.log: Change from monthly to daily rotation (high growth rate of 45.7 MB/day)
